Restaurant.title: Restaurant
Restaurant.description: Central shared restaurant entity containing settings, categories, menu items, modifier groups, and store availability

settings.description: Store settings, logo, name, phone, hours, holidays

categories.description: List of categories with sortOrder, name EN/TH

menuItems.description: List of menu items with name EN/TH, description, price, modifiers, imageUrl, availability

modifierGroups.description: List of modifier groups and options with price and availability

/restaurants/{restaurantId}.description: Master restaurant document accessed across customer and owner devices
